tool.name: analyze_code_security
tool.description: Perform comprehensive security analysis on source code using OpenAI Codex. Identifies vulnerabilities, security flaws, and provides detailed analysis with severity ratings. Best for: analyzing code files, functions, or modules for security issues.

parameter.name: code
parameter.description: Source code to analyze for security vulnerabilities

parameter.name: language
parameter.description: Programming language (python, javascript, java, go, etc.). Default: python

parameter.name: focus_areas
parameter.description: Specific vulnerability types to focus on (e.g., ["SQL injection", "XSS", "authentication"])

returns.description: Security analysis with identified vulnerabilities, severity ratings, and recommendations

tool.example: analyze_code_security(code="def login(username, password):\n query = f'SELECT * FROM users WHERE username={username}'", language="python", focus_areas=["SQL injection"])

tool.name: find_vulnerabilities
tool.description: Search code for specific types of vulnerabilities using Codex. Provides detailed findings with exact locations, exploitation scenarios, and proof of concepts. Best for: targeted vulnerability hunting in code.

parameter.name: code
parameter.description: Source code to search for vulnerabilities

parameter.name: vulnerability_type
parameter.description: Specific vulnerability type to search for (e.g., "SQL injection", "XSS", "SSRF")

returns.description: Detailed vulnerability findings with locations, exploitation methods, and remediation

tool.example: find_vulnerabilities(code="app.get('/user/:id', (req, res) => { db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=' + req.params.id) })", language="javascript", vulnerability_type="SQL injection")

tool.name: explain_code
tool.description: Get detailed explanation of code with security context using Codex. Provides logic breakdown, data flow analysis, and attack surface assessment. Best for: understanding complex code and identifying security implications.

parameter.name: focus
parameter.description: What to focus on. Default: "security implications"

returns.description: Detailed code explanation with security analysis

tool.example:
explain_code(code="@app.route('/upload', methods=['POST'])
def upload():
 file = request.files['file']
 file.save(f'uploads/{file.filename}')", language="python")

tool.name: suggest_fixes
tool.description: Generate secure code fixes for identified vulnerabilities using Codex. Provides production-ready secure replacement code with explanations. Best for: remediating known vulnerabilities with secure alternatives.

parameter.name: vulnerability_description
parameter.description: Description of the vulnerability to fix

returns.description: Secure replacement code with detailed explanation and test cases

tool.example: suggest_fixes(code="cursor.execute(f'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id={user_id}')", vulnerability_description="SQL injection via string formatting", language="python")
